_comment: THE CAGE, NOT THE CREATURE. Tearing this down teaches how a spawner is built; it does not
tell you what to put in one. That comes from Amber, up in the overworld, so the chain needs
both regions and neither half is a shortcut past the other.
scraps_required 4 is the shipped default (FragmentAssemblyRecipe.DEFAULT_REQUIRED), stated
here rather than inherited so the cost of a spawner is visible in the file that sets it.

pools._comment: A spawner cage is iron bars and burnt-out soul residue.
